threat_event: An attacker on a hospital network exploits the IX-3 embedded web server to change pump configuration or drug library limits
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Known vulnerable web server component; maintenance interface reachable on hospital networks; no DCC telemetry from IX-3
existing_controls: Customer security guide recommends network isolation; PSIRT monitoring
treatment_plan: Out-of-cycle IX-3 fix; interim hospital guidance; field campaign

threat_event: IX-3's embedded operating system component loses supplier support and new vulnerabilities cannot be patched
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: End of support June 2027; pumps supported until 2028-12-31
regulatory_driver: N31-33-R05 (524B(b)(2)(A)); FDA premarket guidance (end of support)
treatment_plan: End-of-support plan: extended support contract, compensating controls, trade-in to IX-4

threat_event: An attacker steals or misuses the IX-3 software signing key on the Plant D build server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Software key protected by a passphrase; no HSM, no two-person approval, 4 administrators
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D1 Plant D build server; IX-3 fleet
existing_controls: Server on a restricted plant network segment; EDR
treatment_plan: Move signing to the HSM service or transition IX-3 to a new HSM key in the next field update

threat_event: Malicious code is injected into the CI/CD pipeline and signed as part of an IX-4 or PM-7 release
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pipeline dependencies and build agents reachable by many engineers
existing_controls: Protected branches; signed commits; two-person signing; SOC monitoring
treatment_plan: Hermetic builds and build provenance attestations

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through the flat networks at Plants D and E and halts US-2 production and IX-3 service
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MES, test stations, and office systems share a network; no MES logs in the SIEM
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D1 Plants D and E; BP-MD03; BP-MD08
existing_controls: EDR on office systems; nightly local backups
treatment_plan: Production zones and firewalls as at Plants A to C

threat_event: Attacker activity on Plants D and E MES goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MES and test stations not monitored
treatment_plan: Onboard MES logs; OT network sensor

threat_event: Test results at Plants D and E cannot be tied to a person, so nonconforming devices may be released without accountability
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 19 test stations use shared logins
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D1 test stations; device history records
treatment_plan: Individual badge and PIN sign-in on every station

threat_event: A tenant isolation defect or support misuse exposes one hospital's patients' PHI in the DCC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Multi-tenant database; support staff with standing read access
existing_controls: Tenant isolation tests each release; monthly support access review
treatment_plan: Just-in-time support access with ticket linkage

threat_event: A DCC outage removes remote views and secondary alarm notifications
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Warm standby in provider B
existing_controls: Primary alarms at the bedside; failover tested 2026-03
treatment_plan: Semiannual failover tests

threat_event: A product security event is not linked to MDR, correction, and BAA decisions in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PSIRT procedure and eQMS complaint workflow are separate; BAA terms register incomplete
treatment_plan: Joint PSIRT and complaint workflow; BAA terms register

threat_event: Hospitals do not install IX-3 security updates, so fixed vulnerabilities stay open
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: USB-only updates; 58% adoption
treatment_plan: Field campaign with Distribution service partners; adoption tracking by hospital

threat_event: Vulnerable third-party components go unnoticed because suppliers provide no SBOM data or support dates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 31% of components lack supplier SBOM entries or support end dates
existing_controls: Automated SBOM from builds; composition analysis
treatment_plan: Supplier SBOM clause enforcement; component support register

threat_event: Stale contract manufacturer and supplier accounts in PLM expose designs
threat_source: Former supplier staff or attacker using their accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 164 guest accounts not certified; 38 without expiry
existing_controls: MFA for guests; export screening at onboarding
treatment_plan: Quarterly certification and expiry for all guests

threat_event: A tampered package is distributed through the DCC update service
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Update service accepts only HSM-signed packages; operator access through PAM
treatment_plan: Staged rollout with automatic halt on anomalies

threat_event: Ransomware destroys Plants D and E MES data and device history records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups on local disk only; never restore-tested
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D1 MES at Plants D and E
treatment_plan: Copy to the immutable vault; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: IX-3 firmware changes made at Plant D skip security impact review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plant D change log outside the group change board
treatment_plan: Route IX-3 changes through the group change board

threat_event: A premarket submission lacks the cybersecurity content FDA expects and is delayed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI-001 submission planned 2027 Q2
treatment_plan: Pre-submission meeting for AI-001

threat_event: AI-001 estimates ejection fraction less accurately for some patient groups, misleading clinicians
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Training data under-represents patients with high body mass index and some device models
regulatory_driver: FDA AI-enabled device software guidance (draft); FTC Act Sec. 5
treatment_plan: Complete subgroup testing before design freeze (P10)

threat_event: Engineers paste proprietary code or embargoed vulnerability details into unapproved AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public AI tools reachable from engineering laptops
treatment_plan: Block unapproved tools; approved enterprise coding assistant

threat_event: Medical Devices engineers see competitor data from Testing through the shared collaboration space
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared space open to 212 Medical Devices engineers
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D6 data reachable from Medical Devices
treatment_plan: Close the space; barrier groups; access attestations

threat_event: The primary HSM fails and signing stops
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup HSM at Plant B tested 2026-04
treatment_plan: Accepted: backup HSM covers the risk

threat_event: A foreign-national engineer reaches export-controlled technology in PLM without screening
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Screening at onboarding only
treatment_plan: Rescreen on project changes

threat_event: A stolen engineering laptop exposes design data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted: encryption makes the data unreadable
owner: Medical Devices security and compliance lead

threat_event: A denial-of-service attack degrades DCC device ingestion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Provider DDoS protection; devices buffer data
treatment_plan: Accepted: bedside function unaffected; devices resend

threat_event: Hospitals rely on outdated IX-3 security labeling that omits the end-of-support date
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer security guide last updated 2024
treatment_plan: Update labeling with end-of-support dates and compensating controls

threat_event: A vulnerability report goes unanswered and the researcher discloses publicly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Published CVD policy; 2-business-day acknowledgment met 97% in 2026
treatment_plan: Backup intake rota

threat_event: FDA or customers question penetration test evidence because the in-house Testing division ran it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No documented independence statement for intercompany tests
existing_controls: Testers do not design the products
treatment_plan: Signed independence statements; outside test for IX-3 fix

threat_event: A compromised hospital DCC administrator account changes drug library settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hospital administrators may use password-only sign-in if their federation is not configured
existing_controls: Two-person approval for drug library publication; change alerts to the hospital
treatment_plan: Require MFA for all hospital administrators by 2027-03-31
